title: Ordinary coefficient-first tensor trace projection arrows
statement: Use the ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and their existing derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For any Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category with monoidal preadditive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, define tensorTraceSymmetry on the derived category of sheaves on the small etale site of any scheme to be the canonical Koszul derived tensor symmetry. For a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$, a scheme morphism $f:V\to S$ with a chosen compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support], ordinary derived module objects $L$ on $V$ and $K$ on $S$, and a trace $t:Rf_!L\to A_S$, define tensorTraceProjection by the composite $$Rf_!(Lf^*K\otimes_A^L L)\xrightarrow{Rf_!(\sigma)}Rf_!(L\otimes_A^LLf^*K)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{inv}(\mathrm{PF})}Rf_!L\otimes_A^LK\xrightarrow{\sigma}K\otimes_A^LRf_!L\xrightarrow{1\otimes t}K\otimes_A^LA_S\xrightarrow{\rho}K,$$ using the actual compact-support projection map [def-exchange-projection]. The symbol inv is the existing categorical inverse operator, so no projection-invertibility hypothesis is imposed in this definition; applications on the invertible domain use its genuine inverse. Both symmetries are the specified signed derived symmetries, and the last map is the canonical right unit constraint.
